_description.purpose: Authoritative identity mapping between SimSelections music artists and their verified Discord accounts.

sections.artists: Maps each canonical music artist name to their verified Discord handles (as submitted) and numerical Discord IDs.
sections.handle_lookup: Fast lookup index mapping clean normalized Discord usernames (lowercase, alphanumeric) to the canonical artist names they own.

_description.how_login_works: When an artist logs in via Discord OAuth2, the server normalizes their Discord username (removes spaces, punctuation, lowercase) and queries 'handle_lookup' to find all artist aliases they own.

truck: truck (but with a leading underscore like my discord handle)
